**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation burdening Ono. Targeted searches for favourability language, best-terms/price-parity mechanics, and right-to-match / first-refusal constructs returned only two provisions, neither of which is adverse to us:

- **p0502 (§ IX Product Manufacturing and Supply)** — an MFN-style protection *in our favour*: Array cannot force Ono to order directly from a Subcontractor unless that Subcontractor supplies Ono on terms as favourable as those extended to Array.
- **p0476 (§ VII Payments)** — a mutual tax-cooperation clause to secure the most favourable withholding rate; commercially neutral and not an MFN.

Because Ono owes Array no obligation to extend terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, the preferred element is satisfied and no redline was proposed.
